segments.an8.49:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
segments.an8.49:1.2: Atha kho visākhā migāramātā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe ….
segments.an8.49:1.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho visākhaṃ migāramātaraṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an8.49:2.1: “Catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.49:2.3: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
segments.an8.49:3.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kammantā – uṇṇāti vā kappāsāti vā – tattha dakkhā hoti analasā tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgatā alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
segments.an8.49:3.3: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti.
segments.an8.49:4.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano – dāsāti vā pessāti vā kammakarāti vā – tesaṃ katañca katato jānāti akatañca akatato jānāti, gilānakānañca balābalaṃ jānāti khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyañcassa paccaṃsena saṃvibhajati.
segments.an8.49:4.4: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijano hoti.
segments.an8.49:5.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṅkhātaṃ taṃ jīvitahetupi na ajjhācarati.
segments.an8.49:5.3: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
segments.an8.49:6.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.
segments.an8.49:6.3: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
segments.an8.49:6.4: Imehi kho, visākhe, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.49:7.1: “Catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraloko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.49:7.3: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.49:8.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ –
segments.an8.49:8.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an8.49:8.4: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.49:9.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.an8.49:9.3: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti.
segments.an8.49:10.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgā payatapāṇinī vossaggaratā yācayogā dānasaṃvibhāgaratā.
segments.an8.49:10.3: Evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti.
segments.an8.49:11.2: Idha, visākhe, mātugāmo paññavā hoti … pe … evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.49:12.1: Imehi kho, visākhe, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraloko āraddho hotī”ti.
segments.an8.49:15.1: “Iccete aṭṭha dhammā ca, yassā vijjanti nāriyā;

lines: 49-50. Navame ayaṃ’ sa loko āraddho hotīti ayamassa loko idhaloke karaṇamattāya āraddhattā paripuṇṇattā āraddho hoti paripuṇṇo.
Soḷasākārasampannāti sutte vuttehi aṭṭhahi, gāthāsu aṭṭhahīti soḷasahi ākārehi samannāgatā, yāni vā aṭṭhaṅgāni parampi tesu samādapetīti evampi soḷasākārasampannāti eke.
Sabbasuttesu pana yaṃ na vuttaṃ, taṃ heṭṭhā āgatanayattā uttānatthamevāti.
Yo hi diṭṭhadhammikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti paccatthikaniggaṇhanato sadatthasampādanato ca.

Tenāha “ayaṃsa loko āraddho hotī”ti.(Pasaṃsāvahato tayidaṃ pasaṃsāvahanaṃ kittisaddena idhaloke saddānaṃ cittatosanaviddheyyabhāvāpādanena ca hotīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.) Susaṃvihitakammantoti yāgubhattapacanakālādīni anatikkamitvā tassa tassa sādhukaṃ karaṇena suṭṭhu saṃvihitakammanto.
Yo hi samparāyikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so paralokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti.
